modern: Just as bathing appears to you—oil, sweat, dirt, filthy water, all disgusting things—so is every part of life and everything.
original: Such as bathing appears to thee,—oil, sweat, dirt, filthy water, all things disgusting,—so is every part of life and everything.

notification_original: Such as bathing appears to thee,—oil, sweat, dirt, filthy water, all things disgusting,—so is every part of life and everything.

explained.summary: Think of a Roman bath: oil, sweat, grime, murky water. Marcus finds it all rather disgusting, and says the rest of life is just the same when you look at it closely. It’s a deliberately unglamorous view, meant to stop him from being overly impressed by anything.
